title: Death Note
subtitle: Justice written in ink and blood
description: A brilliant high school student discovers a supernatural notebook that allows him to kill anyone whose name he writes in it, sparking a cat-and-mouse game with the world's greatest detective.
quotes: I am justice! I protect the innocent and punish the guilty!
A world without fear, without anxiety... is that not worth fighting for?
Kira is not a god. He is just a human who happened to find a Death Note.
